sentences.en: Miley Cyrus has spent almost her entire life in the limelight.
sentences.zh: 麦莉·赛勒斯几乎一生都处于聚光灯下。

sentences.en: When she was only 13, she debuted as Disney Channel's Hannah Montana.
sentences.zh: 她13岁时就以迪士尼频道的《汉娜·蒙塔娜》出道。

sentences.en: She played a regular girl by day who had a secret life as a pop star by night.
sentences.zh: 她在剧中饰演一个白天是普通女孩，晚上却有着流行歌星秘密生活的角色。

sentences.en: The role made her into a household name with a string of hits like this one, Party in the
sentences.zh: 这个角色让她家喻户晓，并带来了一系列热门歌曲，比如这首《Party in the

sentences.en: USA.

sentences.en: She gave us the breakup anthem of the decade with her song Wrecking Ball.
sentences.zh: 她用《Wrecking Ball》这首歌为我们带来了那个年代的分手圣歌。

sentences.en: And now in her 30s, her mega hit Flowers spent weeks on top of the charts and won her her first Grammy.
sentences.zh: 如今三十多岁的她，凭借超级热单《Flowers》在榜首停留数周，并赢得了她的首座格莱美奖。

sentences.en: She just released her ninth album, Something Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚发行了第九张专辑《Something Beautiful》。

sentences.en: It's ambitious and personal.
sentences.zh: 这张专辑雄心勃勃且充满个人色彩。

sentences.en: And it's also her first visual album.
sentences.zh: 这也是她的首张视觉专辑。

sentences.en: Let's pretend it's not the end of the world.

sentences.en: and how she's learned to protect herself in a world that is still fascinated by everything she does.
sentences.zh: 以及她是如何学会在一个仍然对她所做的一切着迷的世界中保护自己的。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Miley Cyrus.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与麦莉·赛勒斯的对话。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是那种……我得和陌生人坐在一起。

sentences.en: I sat this year with Cartier, because I was wearing a Laya, who does not have a table.
sentences.zh: 今年我坐在卡地亚那桌，因为我穿的是Laya的衣服，而他们没有专属桌位。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So I was kind of the misfit, which I'm always okay with.
sentences.zh: 所以我算是那个格格不入的人，但我一直都能接受这一点。

sentences.en: I'm used to that.
sentences.zh: 我已经习惯了。

sentences.en: It was fine.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: But it's just an interesting situation, because everything that makes you comfortable is taken from you.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是个有趣的处境，因为所有让你感到舒适的东西都被剥夺了。

sentences.en: You know, it's a, I think they should add, you get a plus one for your styliSt.

sentences.en: Because you're like, you know.

sentences.en: That's why people, I guess, go with their designer sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么人们有时会和他们的设计师一起去。

sentences.en: Because they, totally.
sentences.zh: 因为他们，完全正确。

sentences.en: And my designer is dead.
sentences.zh: 但我的设计师已经去世了。

sentences.en: So who are you sitting with then?
sentences.zh: 那你和谁坐在一起呢？

sentences.en: But I always make friends there.

sentences.en: I love him.
sentences.zh: 我爱他。

sentences.en: A piece, yeah.

sentences.zh: 他是我印象最深刻的嘉宾，因为我坐下来和他聊了很久。

sentences.en: He's super awesome.
sentences.zh: 他超级棒。

sentences.en: He, like, sat down.
sentences.zh: 他坐下来后，

sentences.zh: 问我的第一件事就是：你最喜欢用什么调式唱歌？

sentences.en: Just no one's ever asked me before.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人问过我这个问题。

sentences.en: And he goes, I'm guessing it's a G or a C.
sentences.zh: 他说，我猜是G调或C调。

sentences.en: But I think F would probably be your ceiling.
sentences.zh: 但我认为F调可能是你的极限。

sentences.en: And he sat down and said that right away.
sentences.zh: 他一坐下来就说了这些。

sentences.en: I'm like, you're my friend.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，你是我的朋友。

sentences.en: I like you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你。

sentences.en: And what is your favorite key?
sentences.zh: 那你最喜欢的调式是什么？

sentences.en: He was right.
sentences.zh: 他是对的。

sentences.en: G and C.
sentences.zh: G调和C调。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a little bit about the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊过去。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a little bit about, obviously, your new music.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们也要聊聊你的新音乐。

sentences.en: So we're just going to wonder if at any point you feel whatever, you want to take a break, by all means.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在任何时候感到不适，想休息一下，随时都可以。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I feel good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很好。

sentences.en: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: 那就好。

sentences.en: I like being in this room.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢待在这个房间里。

sentences.en: This room's good.
sentences.zh: 这个房间感觉不错。

sentences.en: Oh, we like it.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们也喜欢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I've got a pretty good compass of, like, where I feel at home now.
sentences.zh: 我现在对哪里让我有归属感有很好的直觉。

sentences.en: And so just being able to sit in a space where you feel really safe, always you get more clarity and more honesty.
sentences.zh: 所以，能够坐在一个让你感到非常安全的地方，总是能让你获得更多的清晰感和诚实感。

sentences.en: And that's what I'm always looking for.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我一直在寻找的。

sentences.en: You know, I've interviewed you before.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我以前采访过你。

sentences.en: You look really familiar to me.
sentences.zh: 你看起来很眼熟。

sentences.en: No, we never saw each other because I was at NPR.
sentences.zh: 不，我们没见过面，因为我当时在NPR工作。

sentences.en: The voice.
sentences.zh: 那个声音。

sentences.en: I was a new host back then.
sentences.zh: 那时我还是个新主持人。

sentences.en: I hadn't done a lot of celebrity interviews.
sentences.zh: 我还没做过很多名人采访。

sentences.en: And you came on and said, ask me anything, anything at all, no holds barred.
sentences.zh: 你当时来的时候说，随便问我什么，什么都可以，毫无保留。

sentences.en: And I had no idea what to do with that.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I literally just froze and thought, I don't know what to ask Miley Cyrus if she's saying, ask me anything.
sentences.zh: 我真的僵住了，心想，如果麦莉·赛勒斯说随便问，我到底该问什么呢？

sentences.en: And I was wondering, as I've watched you kind of evolve, if you would say something like that now, starting an interview.
sentences.zh: 我在想，看着你一路走来，如果你现在开始一场采访，还会说那样的话吗？

sentences.en: It depends who I'm with.
sentences.zh: 那要看我和谁在一起。

sentences.en: I think I would say something like that now, but with, you know, maybe just paying a little closer attention.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在还是会说类似的话，但可能会，你知道，稍微多留个心眼。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you could ask me anything because now I learned that I'm in control, which is probably why I said it to you then.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，你可以问我任何问题，因为现在我学会了掌控局面，这可能就是我当时对你那么说的原因。

sentences.en: The worst that happens is I just leave the room and say, you know, I'll be right back and then just don't come back.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况就是我直接离开房间，说，你知道的，我马上回来，然后就不再回来了。

sentences.en: I'd love for you to explain what that means for you now,
sentences.zh: 我很想让你解释一下这对现在的你意味着什么，

sentences.en: when you have this idea of being in control and being safe and understanding what your own boundaries are and how you interact with people, you know.
sentences.zh: 当你有了这种掌控感、安全感，并且理解了自己的边界以及如何与人互动时。

sentences.en: Because it's animalistic.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一种动物本能。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, everything will change the moment that anyone or any animal is unsafe.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，当任何人或任何动物感到不安全时，一切都会改变。

sentences.en: It's like we all have our different kind of tellers.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有不同的预警信号。

sentences.en: Mine is like all in the throat, which makes so much sense.
sentences.zh: 我的是在喉咙里，这太合理了。

sentences.en: It's where I feel everything.
sentences.zh: 那是我的感知中心。

sentences.en: I can feel like, you know, a tightness or a shortness of breath or I can feel kind of like my skin change of when I feel, you know, that I'm not completely safe.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到，你知道，那种紧绷感或呼吸急促，或者当我感到不完全安全时，我能感觉到皮肤的变化。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've given myself a mantra, don't run, you know, because I can I don't want to leave situations that make me uncomfortable because that's what life is.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我给自己定了一个咒语：不要逃跑。因为我不想离开那些让我不舒服的情况，因为生活就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, we've got to be comfortable being uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们必须学会在不舒服中感到舒适。

sentences.en: But I also am, you know, I'm the mother to myself.
sentences.zh: 但我也是，你知道，我是我自己的母亲。

sentences.en: I mother me.
sentences.zh: 我像母亲一样照顾自己。

sentences.en: How does that play out?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么体现的？

sentences.en: You mother.
sentences.zh: 你像母亲一样照顾自己。

sentences.en: I mean, I love that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我喜欢这个说法。

sentences.en: I've never really heard that because my mom no longer travels with me because I'm 33 years old and it was getting ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听过这种说法，因为我妈妈不再跟我到处旅行了，毕竟我已经33岁了，那样做太荒谬了。

sentences.en: And now she's like an adult and I'm an adult.
sentences.zh: 现在她是成年人，我也是成年人。

sentences.en: And it was really important for me to, you know, I never want to say detach from my mom because we're so close.
sentences.zh: 对我来说非常重要的一点是，你知道，我从不想说要和我妈妈疏远，因为我们太亲密了。

sentences.en: I mean, I'll get tears in my eyes even talking about her.
sentences.zh: 我是说，提到她我都会热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: I just love her so much.
sentences.zh: 我只是太爱她了。

sentences.en: But I at one point we're talking about Tish.
sentences.zh: 但我们刚才是在谈论蒂什。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tish, my mom.
sentences.zh: 蒂什，我妈妈。

sentences.en: She's everything.
sentences.zh: 她是我的全部。

sentences.en: I, you know, I had to learn that, you know, there might be and if nature plays its course in the way that it does, I will be.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我不得不学会，你知道，也许会有那么一天，如果自然规律按照它应有的方式发展，我将会……

sentences.en: And so I guess the reason I said I mother me is because I don't have my mom with me the way that I used to.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜我之所以说我像母亲一样照顾自己，是因为我不再像过去那样有妈妈陪在身边了。

sentences.en: And now I just go, what was it about her that made everything better?
sentences.zh: 现在我只是想，她身上有什么特质让一切变得更好？

sentences.en: And it was safety again.
sentences.zh: 那又是安全感。

sentences.en: Because I knew any situation that I was in that I didn't feel safe in, my mom would get me out of it.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道，任何让我感到不安全的处境，我妈妈都会带我脱离出来。

sentences.en: And or make it better, figure out what it is that was making me feel that way and her helped me adjust it.
sentences.zh: 或者让情况好转，找出让我感到不安的原因，并帮助我调整。

sentences.en: And so now I just imagined what soothed me so much about her.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我只是想象她是如何安抚我的。

sentences.en: And then I just do it for myself.
sentences.zh: 然后我就对自己做同样的事。

sentences.en: You know, you have been famous forever, it feels like.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你好像永远都这么出名。

sentences.en: And these past few years have been absolutely huge for you.
sentences.zh: 过去几年对你来说绝对是巨大的飞跃。

sentences.en: Last year, you won your first Grammy for your song Flowers off your last album.
sentences.zh: 去年，你凭借上一张专辑中的歌曲《Flowers》赢得了首座格莱美奖。

sentences.en: And you exuded so much joy and so much gratitude at that moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻你流露出了如此多的喜悦和感激。

sentences.en: And so I'm wondering why winning meant so much.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，为什么这次获奖对你意义如此重大？

sentences.en: So I think I never admitted to myself how much it hurt me to not always be recognized for my work.
sentences.zh: 我想我从未向自己承认过，不被认可我的工作有多让我受伤。

sentences.en: And, you know, I had a lot of songs that Flowers isn't my only big song.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我有很多歌，《Flowers》并不是我唯一的大热歌曲。

sentences.en: I've had other big songs.
sentences.zh: 我还有其他热门歌曲。

sentences.en: But it was the time that I got recognized for it.
sentences.zh: 但这是我第一次因此获得认可。

sentences.en: And I think I've hidden behind it didn't matter because then every time it happens annually, it would have hurt.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直躲在“这不重要”的借口后面，因为如果每次颁奖季都这样，我会很受伤。

sentences.en: And so when I finally did get recognized, again, it was just like an extra layer of that bandage over something that I didn't even know really hurt me.
sentences.zh: 所以当我最终获得认可时，那就像是在我甚至不知道受伤的地方又贴了一层绷带。

sentences.en: And, you know, now I have enough understanding to say, like, I don't need to win.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在我有足够的理解力去说，我不需要赢。

sentences.en: But like anyone, I want to.
sentences.zh: 但像任何人一样，我还是想赢。

sentences.en: Why do you think it took so long?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么花了这么久？

sentences.en: I think when you do things your own way, you're always respectfully a little bit ahead because I like to open the door.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当你按自己的方式做事时，你总是会因为我喜欢主动开门而显得稍微领先一点。

sentences.en: I, you know, it's nice when someone opens it for you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有人为你开门固然很好。

sentences.en: But I kind of like to be in front and open the door myself.
sentences.zh: 但我还是喜欢走在前面，自己开门。

sentences.en: And I think women that are loud and, you know, open with their sexuality.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为那些性格张扬、对性观念开放的女性……

sentences.en: And I don't want to hide behind that.
sentences.zh: 我不想躲在这些标签背后。

sentences.en: But I do think something of my – there's a couple things.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得我的……有几件事是这样的。

sentences.en: Let's go back.
sentences.zh: 我们回过头来说。

sentences.en: I think from starting from being on Disney, you already have something that you kind of have to overcome,
sentences.zh: 我觉得从迪士尼出道开始，你就已经背负了一些需要去克服的东西，

sentences.en: which I've never understood needing to overcome Disney or being Hannah Montana because Hannah Montana was like a singer.
sentences.zh: 但我从来不理解为什么非要克服迪士尼或汉娜·蒙塔娜这个身份，因为汉娜·蒙塔娜就像个歌手。

sentences.en: And I was never nominated for Best New Artist, which was totally cool with me.
sentences.zh: 我从未获得过最佳新人奖提名，这对我来说完全没问题。

sentences.en: But at one point, I just think I kind of was the Best New ArtiSt.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时刻，我确实觉得自己算是最佳新人。

sentences.en: And if it wasn't the best, it was the most impactful to a certain generation that there should be some sort of recognition for that.
sentences.zh: 如果说不是最好的，那至少是对某一代人最有影响力的，理应得到某种认可。

sentences.en: And also the amount of work that I was putting in was so heavy.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时投入的工作量非常巨大。

sentences.en: So I think with the Grammys, it was like overcoming Disney, overcoming the character.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对于格莱美来说，这就像是在克服迪士尼、克服那个角色。

sentences.en: And then when I left the character behind, like all the way behind, like it was like, okay, cut.
sentences.zh: 后来当我把那个角色抛在脑后，彻底抛在脑后时，就像是，好吧，切断了。

sentences.en: I am officially like so me that I think I just went so many steps ahead really faSt.
sentences.zh: 我正式地做回了自己，我觉得我一下子向前迈进了许多步，真的很快。

sentences.en: And I don't think that everyone could completely keep up.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得并不是每个人都能完全跟上。

sentences.en: But then also female rebellion has always been something that takes a little while for critics and for, you know, sophisticated shows to totally take that woman seriously.
sentences.zh: 但同时，女性的反叛总是需要一段时间才能让评论家和那些所谓的“高级”节目真正认真对待。

sentences.en: There's a lot there to unpack.
sentences.zh: 这里面有很多值得深究的东西。

sentences.en: I was breathless, but no, no, there's just like there's a lot there.
sentences.zh: 我刚才说得喘不过气了，不，不，只是这里面确实有很多东西。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm really interested with the idea of having to overcome your Hannah Montana days in the sense of being considered a real artiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的很感兴趣关于“必须克服汉娜·蒙塔娜时期”才能被视为一名真正艺术家的这种想法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's what I think it kind of was.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我觉得大概就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, that somehow the machinery of Disney and how it's, you know, been the place that a lot of people have come from.
sentences.zh: 是的，某种程度上迪士尼的运作机制，你知道，它是很多人的起点。

sentences.en: But there were other Disney artists that got dominated in that category.
sentences.zh: 但也有其他迪士尼艺人在那个类别中获得了提名。

sentences.en: But they, I believe, I don't know who else before that, but the Jonas Brothers.
sentences.zh: 但我相信，我不知道在那之前还有谁，但乔纳斯兄弟确实有过。

sentences.en: But it was boys.
sentences.zh: 但他们是男生。

sentences.en: And so they didn't have like a character to shed.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不需要摆脱什么角色包袱。

sentences.en: But because I wore a wig and I was a pop star, you know, I remember being brokenhearted because the Jonas Brothers, I believe, got asked to perform with Stevie Wonder.
sentences.zh: 但因为我戴着假发，是个流行歌星，你知道，我记得当时很心碎，因为我相信乔纳斯兄弟受邀与史蒂夫·汪达同台演出。

sentences.en: And, you know, I never got an opportunity like that as a young girl when my show had been on air for years before.
sentences.zh: 而你知道，我作为一个年轻女孩，从未得到过那样的机会，尽管我的节目已经播出了好几年。

sentences.en: And I had had everyone on that show with Dolly Parton.
sentences.zh: 而且我还在节目里请过桃莉·巴顿。

sentences.en: We've had Vicki Lawrence who like taught me so many amazing things.
sentences.zh: 我们还请过薇琪·劳伦斯，她教了我很多了不起的东西。

sentences.en: It actually was the greatest blessing, though, that those awards never happened because I was recognized all the time by millions of people that were really, you know,
sentences.zh: 不过，那些奖项从未降临其实是最大的福分，因为我一直被数以百万计的人认可，他们真的，你知道，

sentences.en: their identities were being formed by me.
sentences.zh: 他们的身份认同是由我塑造的。

sentences.en: There's a part of them that's like a little part of me.
sentences.zh: 他们身上有一部分就像是我的一小部分。

sentences.en: And so it's like I love that people became my, you know, my reward is that people loved me and that felt good.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢人们成为我的……你知道，我的回报就是人们爱我，那种感觉很好。

sentences.en: But, you know, of course, every year, you know, never having my name called and I was just working so hard.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，每年，你知道，我的名字从未被叫到，而我一直在努力工作。

sentences.en: And I did feel like there was, you know, not necessarily saying I am owed it or I deserve it, but it just felt like what am I not doing?
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得，你知道，并不是说我欠缺什么或者我理应得到，但就是感觉，我到底哪里没做到？

sentences.en: Where's the math?
sentences.zh: 算式在哪里？

sentences.en: Because I feel like if we're doing the equation, I feel like it equals some sort of, you know, just validation, physical validation.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得如果我们是在做方程式，我觉得它应该等于某种，你知道，纯粹的验证，实质性的验证。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I want to talk about the new album, Something Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈新专辑《Something Beautiful》。

sentences.en: I've always had a bit of trouble pinning your music down because you are always experimenting in this way that's innovative.
sentences.zh: 我一直很难定义你的音乐，因为你总是以这种创新的方式进行实验。

sentences.en: You go through different genres, different types of music.
sentences.zh: 你尝试不同的流派，不同的音乐类型。

sentences.en: And so I'd love to know what you're trying to do with this album.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道你在这张专辑里想做什么。

sentences.en: I have a hard time pinning myself down, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很难定义我自己。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't say that all my albums are even necessarily reflective of what I would say or who I would say I am as an artist or musician.
sentences.zh: 我不会说我所有的专辑都一定反映了我想说的，或者反映了作为艺术家或音乐人的我是谁。

sentences.en: Sometimes my albums, you know, are experimentation for me and they end up being shared.
sentences.zh: 有时我的专辑，你知道，是对我而言的实验，最后被分享了出来。

sentences.en: And so with Something Beautiful, I wanted to, you know, reclaim and reimagine the word beautiful and what it means to me.
sentences.zh: 所以对于《Something Beautiful》，我想，你知道，重新定义和构想“美丽”这个词，以及它对我意味着什么。

sentences.en: Some of the most beautiful moments in my life, you know, I am also very emotional.
sentences.zh: 我生命中一些最美好的时刻，你知道，我也非常感性。

sentences.en: I cry about everything, so I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我什么都会哭，所以我没问题。

sentences.en: You know, but when I think about, you know, being born, the first person that I saw was my grandma.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但当我想到，你知道，我出生时，我见到的第一个人是我奶奶。

sentences.en: And it gets me emotional.
sentences.zh: 这让我很感动。

sentences.en: And, you know, my mom was adopted.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我妈妈是被领养的。

sentences.en: And so being able to be put into her arms and immediately think, it just, it's deep.
sentences.zh: 所以能被抱进她的怀里，立刻想到这些，这真的很深刻。

sentences.en: It's like way before me, you know, there's so much there.
sentences.zh: 就像是在我很久之前，你知道，那里有很多东西。

sentences.en: And when I think about these moments in my life being handed to her when I was first born and then, you know, when she passed away, both of those moments were so beautiful to me.
sentences.zh: 当我想到我生命中的这些时刻，刚出生时被交到她怀里，然后，你知道，当她去世时，这两个时刻对我来说都非常美丽。

sentences.en: And one of them is really joyous and one of them is really painful, but they're equally beautiful.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是充满喜悦的，一个是极其痛苦的，但它们同样美丽。

sentences.en: That's why I think I've made this album is just to reclaim what beauty is, because I think birth is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为我制作了这张专辑，只是为了重新定义什么是美，因为我认为出生是美丽的。

sentences.en: I think death is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我认为死亡也是美丽的。

sentences.en: I think we've been taught, too, that, like, rage or hatefulness, you know, there's not a beauty in it, but it lets you know you're alive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们也被教导过，比如愤怒或仇恨，你知道，它们没什么美感，但它们让你知道你还活着。

sentences.en: You're feeling something.
sentences.zh: 你在感受某些东西。

sentences.en: I'm a big believer in rage.
sentences.zh: 我非常相信愤怒的力量。

sentences.en: You have to get it out.
sentences.zh: 你必须把它释放出来。

sentences.en: I had physical pain in my body for years, and I realized it's because I didn't let myself be angry.
sentences.zh: 我多年来身体一直有疼痛，后来我意识到是因为我没让自己生气。

sentences.en: A lot of women, I think, that I've known that go, man, I have hip pain or have joint pain, and then I watch them in their lives, you know, yes, please, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我认识的很多女性，她们会说，天哪，我髋部疼或关节疼，然后我观察她们的生活，你知道，总是“好的，请，谢谢”。

sentences.en: You know, my mom does this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我妈妈就是这样。

sentences.en: She could order a baked potato, a cake could come, and she'll say, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 她点个烤土豆，送来个蛋糕，她也会说，太谢谢你了。

sentences.en: You know, she's always polite, and she had all these headaches all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她总是很有礼貌，但她一直头痛不断。

sentences.en: And I told her, I was like, mom, you got to get real mad.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，我说，妈，你得真的发火才行。

sentences.en: So I think rage and anger is something that we should let ourselves feel, but it's just, you know, keep it to yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为愤怒是一种我们应该让自己去感受的情绪，但只是，你知道，放在心里就好。

sentences.en: You know, you use it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你要利用它。

sentences.en: That's what I want to do with the things that make me, you know, angry or even hateful.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想用那些让我，你知道，愤怒甚至仇恨的事情去做的事。

sentences.en: When was the last time you felt rage?
sentences.zh: 你上一次感到愤怒是什么时候？

sentences.en: The last time I felt rage.
sentences.zh: 我上一次感到愤怒。

sentences.en: I think, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Again, I get way too emotional, but true rage is, I think, probably to do with my mom, you know, or my sister.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我太容易情绪化了，但真正的愤怒，我想，可能与我妈妈有关，你知道，或者我姐姐。

sentences.en: It's like the way that, it's not rage.
sentences.zh: 就像那种方式，那不是愤怒。

sentences.en: Real rage, you know what, I can actually know when.
sentences.zh: 真正的愤怒，你知道吗，我其实知道是什么时候。

sentences.en: It's real rage was after I made an album, Plastic Hearts, and I felt myself getting caught into an idea of me, like this tornado of the idea of me, and I fell for it,
sentences.zh: 真正的愤怒是在我制作了《Plastic Hearts》专辑之后，我感到自己陷入了一个关于“我”的概念中，就像一场关于“我”的龙卷风，我沉迷其中，

sentences.en: and I got inside of it.
sentences.zh: 我陷进去了。

sentences.en: And when I actually landed and came back down, I realized the vortex I had been in, and when I looked around and thought of the people that I had placed in my life to keep me safe,
sentences.zh: 当我真正落地回到现实时，我意识到我曾身处漩涡之中，当我环顾四周，想到那些我为了保护自己而安插在身边的人，

sentences.en: and they didn't, I had rage.
sentences.zh: 而他们并没有保护我，我感到了愤怒。

sentences.en: Because I actually, I don't need anyone to commit to taking care of me.
sentences.zh: 因为我其实并不需要任何人承诺照顾我。

sentences.en: But don't say you will.
sentences.zh: 但别说你会。

sentences.en: I understand that this is sensitive, so forgive me, and you can just move on.
sentences.zh: 我明白这很敏感，所以请原谅我，你可以跳过这个话题。

sentences.en: But obviously this was the period after your divorce, and so.
sentences.zh: 但显然这是在你离婚后的那段时期，所以……

sentences.en: Weirdly, I'm not talking about him.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我说的不是他。

sentences.en: Okay, that's what I'm just, because sometimes I think people talk about things, but they're not talking about it, and I'm just trying to.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我只是……因为有时我觉得人们谈论事情，但他们并不是在谈论那件事，而我只是想……

sentences.en: No, mine is more, just like actually in my industry, you know, I have a full new creative team around me, who I have in the studio, who I create music with now.
sentences.zh: 不，我更多的是指，实际上在我的行业里，你知道，我身边有一个全新的创意团队，他们现在在录音室里和我一起创作音乐。

sentences.en: And I think this is why my last two albums are the ones where you can hear me the cleanest and the cleareSt.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么我的最后两张专辑是你听起来最干净、最清晰的作品。

sentences.en: What is a Miley Cyrus song?
sentences.zh: 什么是麦莉·赛勒斯的歌？

sentences.en: If you had to say, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你必须说的话，你知道。

sentences.en: There's like two.
sentences.zh: 大概有两种。

sentences.en: There's two.
sentences.zh: 有两种。

sentences.en: I heard that there's only two or three genres.
sentences.zh: 我听说只有两三种流派。

sentences.en: There's normal people that make normal music for like normal people.
sentences.zh: 有为普通人制作普通音乐的普通人。

sentences.en: Then there's weird people, and we all know that kind of music, that make weird music for weird people.
sentences.zh: 然后是怪人，我们都知道那种音乐，他们为怪人制作奇怪的音乐。

sentences.en: And then there's weird people that have learned how to make normal music and kind of normal people that know how to make weird music.
sentences.zh: 还有学会制作普通音乐的怪人，以及知道如何制作奇怪音乐的普通人。

sentences.en: And there's only normal and weird, and that's kind of it.
sentences.zh: 所以只有普通和奇怪，大概就是这样。

sentences.en: So I think I make normal music, and I also make weird music.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我既制作普通音乐，也制作奇怪音乐。

sentences.en: So like flowers is kind of like normal music, meaning you can understand it.
sentences.zh: 所以像《Flowers》这种算是普通音乐，意思是你可以听懂它。

sentences.en: You know, you don't have to question, you know, anything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不需要去质疑，你知道，任何东西。

sentences.en: After you listen to it, you can just simply enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 听完之后，你只需简单地享受它。

sentences.en: And then I like to make weird music, which is like a song on Something Beautiful, like Prelude or the title track, Something Beautiful,
sentences.zh: 然后我喜欢制作奇怪的音乐，比如《Something Beautiful》里的一首歌，像《Prelude》或者同名主打歌《Something Beautiful》，

sentences.en: that just makes you question a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 那会让你多质疑一点。

sentences.en: So I think Miley's songs are either normal music or weird music.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为麦莉的歌要么是普通音乐，要么是奇怪音乐。

sentences.en: You know, I don't love the middle.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不喜欢中间地带。

sentences.en: The lead single off of Something Beautiful is called The End of the World.
sentences.zh: 《Something Beautiful》的主打单曲叫《The End of the World》。

sentences.en: And you've talked about how it's a song you wrote for your mom in a hard moment.
sentences.zh: 你谈到过这是你在一个艰难时刻为你妈妈写的歌。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about writing it?
sentences.zh: 能跟我说说创作它的过程吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: So that was completely ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 那件事简直太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Like I said, me and my mom are very close, but it is ridiculous at some points because she went on a vacation to Italy without me for one week.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我和我妈非常亲近，但在某些方面确实很荒谬，因为她去意大利度假了一周，没带我。

sentences.en: And it felt like the end of the world to the both of us.
sentences.zh: 对我们俩来说，那感觉就像世界末日一样。

sentences.en: She called me—
sentences.zh: 她给我打电话——

sentences.en: That's what the song's about?
sentences.zh: 这首歌就是关于这个的？

sentences.en: That was what it was about.
sentences.zh: 就是关于那个的。

sentences.en: I had never had my mom leave the country without me before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未有过我妈离开这个国家而不带我的经历。

sentences.en: And again, too old maybe to feel that way, but that's how I feel.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，也许我太大了不该有这种感觉，但这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: And my mom called me and she said, I don't know why, but I just—I want to cry today.
sentences.zh: 我妈给我打电话说，我不知道为什么，但我只是……我今天想哭。

sentences.en: Like, I forgot where they were.
sentences.zh: 就像，我忘了他们在哪里了。

sentences.en: Some were gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 有些地方很美。

sentences.en: And she's like, I just—I'm looking out my window and there's nothing out there for me because, like, you're back home.
sentences.zh: 她说，我只是……我看着窗外，外面对我来说什么都没有，因为，你知道，你还在家里。

sentences.en: And the first lyric is, today you woke up and you told me that you wanted to cry.
sentences.zh: 第一句歌词是：今天你醒来，告诉我你想哭。

sentences.en: That was my mom.
sentences.zh: 那是我妈妈。

sentences.en: You sang the song at the Chateau Marmont and you got really emotional during it.
sentences.zh: 你在马尔蒙庄园演唱这首歌时非常动情。

sentences.en: What was going on there?
sentences.zh: 当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: My mom was right in the front row and, you know, there's a part—it does it to me now.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈就在前排，你知道，有一部分……现在唱起来还是会这样。

sentences.en: There's a lyric that says, you've been thinking about the future like it's already yours.
sentences.zh: 有一句歌词说：你一直在思考未来，好像它已经是你的一样。

sentences.en: And to me, that was just like a lyric about kind of not only mortality, but also just, yeah, that every day isn't promised to us.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那不仅仅是关于死亡的歌词，也是关于，是的，每一天都不是注定属于我们的。

sentences.en: So worrying about the future that may never come is so pointless.
sentences.zh: 所以担心可能永远不会到来的未来是毫无意义的。

sentences.en: But then me thinking about a future without her just breaks my heart.
sentences.zh: 但想到没有她的未来，我的心就碎了。

sentences.en: So that lyric gets me every time.
sentences.zh: 所以那句歌词每次都让我触动。

sentences.en: You're also releasing a film to go with the album, and that's a first for you.
sentences.zh: 你还要发行一部与专辑配套的电影，这对你来说是第一次。

sentences.en: Why did you want to make a film?
sentences.zh: 为什么你想拍电影？

sentences.en: You know, it's a visual album, and the reason I chose to do it was because I wanted to do one thing extremely well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一张视觉专辑，我选择这样做是因为我想把一件事做得极其出色。

sentences.en: You know, my stepdad asked me the other day, why are you the only one without a makeup line?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我继父前几天问我，为什么你是唯一一个没有化妆品系列的人？

sentences.en: I was like, because I don't—that's not my passion.
sentences.zh: 我说，因为我不……那不是我的热情所在。

sentences.en: And he goes, that's the right answer.
sentences.zh: 他说，那是正确的答案。

sentences.en: And it made so much sense.
sentences.zh: 这非常有道理。

sentences.en: It's like, I don't have a makeup line because I'm not a makeup artiSt.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我没有化妆品系列，因为我不是化妆师。

sentences.en: And some people operate differently, you know.
sentences.zh: 有些人运作方式不同，你知道。

sentences.en: And Dolly's always says, you do you and I'll do me.
sentences.zh: 桃莉总是说，做你自己，我会做我自己。

sentences.en: Together will be us.
sentences.zh: 在一起我们就是我们。

sentences.en: Because this woman has cupcakes, you know, perfume, amusement parks, all the things.
sentences.zh: 因为这个女人有纸杯蛋糕，你知道，香水，游乐园，所有这些东西。

sentences.en: I never felt like that was really for me.
sentences.zh: 我从来没觉得那些真的适合我。

sentences.en: And I've always admired that she can and wants.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直很钦佩她能做到并且想要做到。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like a deep passion of her.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就像是她内心深处的热情。

sentences.en: She absolutely adores it.
sentences.zh: 她绝对热爱这些。

sentences.en: To me, it's me by a piano writing songs and telling my stories and then creating a gorgeous visual in support of that.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，就是我坐在钢琴前写歌、讲故事，然后为此打造出华丽的视觉效果。

sentences.en: That's what I love to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我热爱做的事。

sentences.en: It brings to mind a question that I've always had, which is you started your career as an actor and a singer, obviously.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个我一直有的疑问，显然你是以演员和歌手的身份开启职业生涯的。

sentences.en: But you, other than a few brief acting gigs, really kind of left that behind.
sentences.zh: 但除了几次短暂的表演经历，你基本上就把演戏抛在脑后了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's actually really interesting because I got Hannah Montana because I was a singer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这其实很有意思，因为我能得到《汉娜·蒙塔娜》这个角色是因为我是个歌手。

sentences.en: So I was singing in Nashville.
sentences.zh: 当时我在纳什维尔唱歌。

sentences.en: There was a little place at our mall where you could go and make demos.
sentences.zh: 我们商场里有个小地方，你可以去录制小样。

sentences.en: This is Nashville for you.
sentences.zh: 这就是纳什维尔的特色。

sentences.en: You know, Nashville is like, we don't have a Build-A-Bear.
sentences.zh: 你知道，纳什维尔就像是……我们没有那种“Build-A-Bear”玩偶店。

sentences.en: We have like, build a country music star.
sentences.zh: 我们有的是“打造乡村音乐明星”的地方。

sentences.en: So I used to go to the mall and make my demos and write my songs.
sentences.zh: 所以我以前常去商场录小样、写歌。

sentences.en: And they were looking for someone that could, you know, really sing, not just record kids' music, but actually have music being the heart of the show.
sentences.zh: 他们当时在找一个真正能唱歌的人，不是那种录儿歌的，而是能让音乐成为剧集核心的人。

sentences.en: So I got known as being an actress, but I actually hadn't acted in anything.
sentences.zh: 所以我以演员的身份出名了，但其实我之前什么都没演过。

sentences.en: I had been in a Big Bean commercial with Leanne Womack, and I had two lines in a Tim Burton movie one time.
sentences.zh: 我曾和莉安·沃马克拍过一个Big Bean的广告，还在蒂姆·伯顿的电影里演过两句台词。

sentences.en: I was not an actress.
sentences.zh: 我根本不是个演员。

sentences.en: And so I, you know, became an actress so I could bring that part to life.
sentences.zh: 所以我，你知道，我成了演员，这样我才能把那个角色演活。

sentences.en: And then I've just never really found the role for me because I think I am such a character in myself that to find something that can absorb me completely is really challenging.
sentences.zh: 后来我一直没找到适合我的角色，因为我觉得我本身就是一个很有个性的人，要找到一个能完全包容我的角色真的很有挑战性。

sentences.en: And I challenge every writer and director out there to bring it to me because I would love to.
sentences.zh: 我向所有的编剧和导演发起挑战，把剧本拿来给我，因为我很乐意尝试。

sentences.en: I just need, I either want to be myself because I'm really good at that, or I want to throw me away because I'm actually pretty good at that too.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要……要么我想做回自己，因为我很擅长这个；要么我想彻底抛弃自我，因为我也挺擅长这个的。

sentences.en: I'm not good in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我不擅长中间地带。

sentences.en: I want to take you, we've touched on this, but your sort of upbringing, obviously your dad was Billy Ray Cyrus.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊你，我们之前提到过，关于你的成长环境，显然你父亲是比利·雷·赛勒斯。

sentences.en: And is.
sentences.zh: 而且现在也是。

sentences.en: And is.
sentences.zh: 而且现在也是。

sentences.en: He's living.
sentences.zh: 他还健在。

sentences.en: He's living.
sentences.zh: 他还健在。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's living.
sentences.zh: 对，他还健在。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Um, I was curious about little Miley.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很好奇小时候的麦莉。

sentences.en: When did you realize that you had this talent that you could really sing?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候意识到自己有唱歌天赋的？

sentences.en: Not just sing, sing, but sing.
sentences.zh: 不是那种随便唱唱，而是真正能唱歌。

sentences.en: Well, even more than that, people just used to pay attention to me in weird ways that I noticed that,
sentences.zh: 嗯，甚至不止于此，人们以前总是以一种奇怪的方式关注我，我注意到，

sentences.en: like, when I would go somewhere, like, not everyone was being kind of like looked at or treated the way that I was.
sentences.zh: 比如，当我走到哪里时，并不是每个人都会像我这样被注视或对待。

sentences.en: I used to have this thing when my mom, my mom was like a total shopaholic when I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候有件事，我妈是个十足的购物狂。

sentences.en: She would take me to the mall, which is the worst place for a kid with like a bad attention span.
sentences.zh: 她会带我去商场，这对一个注意力不集中的孩子来说简直是噩梦。

sentences.en: And my favorite thing to do would to be going into the front of the stores and pretend I was a mannequin.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢做的事就是走到店门口，假装自己是个模特人偶。

sentences.en: And I would hold it for so long, I would not budge.
sentences.zh: 我会保持那个姿势很久，一动不动。

sentences.en: And I would get crowds of people around staring at me because I was just like milking it so hard.
sentences.zh: 我会引来一群人盯着我看，因为我当时真的很卖力地在演。

sentences.en: And they, I think they were like, how long is this little girl going to like keep up the bit?
sentences.zh: 我想他们当时在想，这个小女孩到底要演多久？

sentences.en: And I would just do the bit.
sentences.zh: 而我就会一直演下去。

sentences.en: And so I, you know, I definitely noticed that like people kind of, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我，你知道，我确实注意到人们，你知道，

sentences.en: there was something magnetic between me and other people.
sentences.zh: 我和其他人之间有一种磁场。

sentences.en: And I don't say they were magnetized to me.
sentences.zh: 我不是说他们被我吸引。

sentences.en: I was actually like magnet.
sentences.zh: 其实我才是那个磁铁。

sentences.en: We were, we were to each other.
sentences.zh: 我们对彼此都有吸引力。

sentences.en: But then with the singing, you know, I, I would just always sing on stage.
sentences.zh: 但说到唱歌，你知道，我总是会在舞台上唱歌。

sentences.en: And I didn't know if people were just cheering because I was, you know, like little.
sentences.zh: 我不知道人们欢呼是因为我，你知道，因为我年纪小。

sentences.en: And it was cute for me to come out and do like Elvis songs or whatever.
sentences.zh: 而且我出来唱猫王的歌什么的很可爱。

sentences.en: But I guess I never really thought like, oh, I can really sing.
sentences.zh: 但我从没想过“哦，我真的会唱歌”。

sentences.en: I just know that people were reacting.
sentences.zh: 我只知道人们有反应。

sentences.en: And so that's what I was going off of.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是靠这个来判断的。

sentences.en: I wasn't thinking about, is this good or bad?
sentences.zh: 我没想过这到底是好是坏。

sentences.en: I was just watching people light up and going like, yeah, that's what I want.
sentences.zh: 我只是看着人们兴奋起来，心想：对，这就是我想要的。

sentences.en: I want you to react to me.
sentences.zh: 我想要你们对我做出反应。

sentences.en: I heard you mention briefly in a recent interview with David Letterman that you were bullied in middle school
sentences.zh: 我听你在最近接受大卫·莱特曼采访时提到，你在初中时曾遭受霸凌，

sentences.en: before you left for Hollywood and Hannah Montana.
sentences.zh: 在你去好莱坞拍《汉娜·蒙塔娜》之前。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm, I'm the mother of a 12 year old girl and.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我是一个12岁女孩的母亲，

sentences.en: Ouch.
sentences.zh: 哎哟。

sentences.en: I feel for her.
sentences.zh: 我为她感到难过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Middle school is terrible.
sentences.zh: 初中生活太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering what you took away from that period of your life where all of a sudden you go off to have like this amazing success.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你从那段生活中得到了什么，因为你突然就获得了巨大的成功，

sentences.en: But, you know, you had this really painful time.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，你曾经历过那段非常痛苦的时期。

sentences.en: Like, why was that happening?
sentences.zh: 为什么会发生那种事？

sentences.en: I don't know if there was a reason, you know, that I was like specifically chosen to be bullied.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是不是有什么原因，你知道，我被专门挑出来霸凌。

sentences.en: I think a lot of what did it for me in middle school was the attention that I had on me because of my dad.
sentences.zh: 我觉得初中时发生这一切很大程度上是因为我父亲带来的关注度。

sentences.en: And just, you know, people like.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们……

sentences.en: I guess putting on to me that I thought that I was, you know, special in this other way.
sentences.zh: 我想他们觉得我自以为在某些方面很特别。

sentences.en: And it's so it wasn't about I don't think what hurt them was that I was special, but it was that it just made them feel not special.
sentences.zh: 其实伤害他们的并不是我有多特别，而是这让他们觉得自己不特别。

sentences.en: And I also, you know, as outgoing as I was, middle school was kind of a shy time for me.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，尽管我很外向，但初中对我来说是一段比较内向的时期。

sentences.en: I kind of shut down at that time just because, you know, bullying just takes so much from you.
sentences.zh: 那段时间我有点封闭自己，因为你知道，霸凌会从你身上夺走太多东西。

sentences.en: You just don't want attention.
sentences.zh: 你根本不想引人注意。

sentences.en: And so I kind of like wanted to be under the radar when I was in middle school.
sentences.zh: 所以我在初中时只想保持低调。

sentences.en: I chilled out, you know, when I was like in elementary school, I liked all the attention.
sentences.zh: 我放松下来了，你知道，我在小学时很喜欢那种关注。

sentences.en: But then once I got to middle school, I didn't like it so much because people got too mean, too cruel.
sentences.zh: 但到了初中，我就没那么喜欢了，因为人们变得太刻薄、太残忍。

sentences.en: And I didn't, you know, I didn't like have all the boyfriends or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道，我没有交很多男朋友之类的。

sentences.en: Like I just I juSt.
sentences.zh: 我只是……我只是……

sentences.en: There's like four guys I'm thinking of that I'm like you like I really like so many guys and like they just weren't really liking me back quite as much.
sentences.zh: 我能想到四个人，我当时想，我真的很喜欢很多男生，但他们并没有那么喜欢我。

sentences.en: And it was like I just wasn't I wasn't the most like popular girl in school.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时并不是学校里最受欢迎的女孩。

sentences.en: So you end up going to Hollywood and you do Hannah Montana.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终去了好莱坞，拍了《汉娜·蒙塔娜》。

sentences.en: And it's interesting that we've been talking a little bit about getting over Disney because I had another former Disney star who's now an actor, Jenna Ortega.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们一直在谈论摆脱迪士尼的影响，因为我采访过另一位前迪士尼童星，现在是演员的珍娜·奥尔特加。

sentences.en: Tell me that she can always tell in a room who is the child actor, that there's like a certain noticeable precociousness.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她总能在房间里一眼看出谁是童星，因为有一种明显的早熟感。

sentences.en: She said people just treat you as if you're an adult and that it kind of warps you.
sentences.zh: 她说人们把你当作成年人对待，这会扭曲你的成长。

sentences.en: Do you think that that resonates?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这有共鸣吗？

sentences.en: I, you know, I was just literally still thinking about middle school.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我刚才真的还在想初中的事。

sentences.en: I'm really hoping in the comments of this interview, someone goes, Miley's lying.
sentences.zh: 我真希望这次采访的评论区里有人会说：“麦莉在撒谎。”

sentences.en: She was really popular in school.
sentences.zh: “她在学校里其实很受欢迎。”

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, my God, I was popular.
sentences.zh: 然后我会说：“天哪，原来我很受欢迎。”

sentences.en: Maybe maybe I was like, I feel like I like I wasn't.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，也许我当时……我觉得我好像并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: That's what I was really totally spacing out when you were saying that.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说那些的时候，我完全走神了。

sentences.en: I could tell that you were like not with me at all.
sentences.zh: 我看得出来你完全没跟上我的节奏。

sentences.en: I was really hoping that someone will go like, you're just trying to say you weren't popular.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望有人会说：“你只是想假装自己不受欢迎。”

sentences.en: You totally were.
sentences.zh: “你明明很受欢迎。”

sentences.en: I really hope that I was, but I don't think I was.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我当时受欢迎，但我觉得我没有。

sentences.en: But maybe I was.
sentences.zh: 但也许我真的有。

sentences.en: But my point about that with the child acting, it actually correlates to that because I don't know how she feels about it.
sentences.zh: 不过关于童星的那点，这其实是相关的，因为我不知道她对此有什么感觉。

sentences.en: I've never actually got to speak to her.
sentences.zh: 我还没机会和她聊过。

sentences.en: I would totally love to.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想聊聊。

sentences.en: I think people that grew up in the same position would be really sick to do like a roundtable.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在同样环境下长大的人聚在一起开个圆桌会议会很酷。

sentences.en: I think you should all be in a group chat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们应该建个群聊。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Ariana says that there should be, you know, the therapy for child actors, which I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 爱莉安娜说应该有针对童星的心理治疗，我完全同意。

sentences.en: Like there should be a weekly, you know, check in.
sentences.zh: 应该有每周一次的心理疏导。

sentences.en: There should be like a better system of community because I don't know her.
sentences.zh: 应该建立一个更好的社区系统，因为我不认识她。

sentences.en: I would definitely love to.
sentences.zh: 我绝对很乐意。

sentences.en: I think that I've done, you know, so this is only me, nothing to do with what she said.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经做到了，你知道，这只是我个人的情况，和她说的无关。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I've been, you know, doing very consistent, you know, therapy since I was 17 or 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 我从17或18岁起就一直在进行非常稳定的心理治疗。

sentences.en: And so I think I've cleared up a lot of the feelings that I had about being, you know, like a child star.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我已经清理掉了很多关于作为童星的负面情绪。

sentences.en: And so now I don't notice it so much because I don't notice it in me.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我没那么在意了，因为我自己身上已经没有那种感觉了。

sentences.en: It's always about us.
sentences.zh: 这总是关于我们自己。

sentences.en: You know, I've realized that anything that you're paying attention to usually is just a reflection of something else that you feel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我意识到你所关注的任何事情，通常都只是你内心感受的投射。

sentences.en: So I feel so cleaned up.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉自己清理得很干净。

sentences.en: Like I cleaned so much of any of that old stuff that I held on to that now when I walk into a room, I don't really notice it.
sentences.zh: 我清理掉了那么多我曾紧抓不放的旧东西，以至于现在走进一个房间，我真的不会再注意到那些了。

sentences.en: I guess the only thing that I would say is I do notice when people are working too hard.
sentences.zh: 我想我唯一会说的是，我确实会注意到人们是否工作过度。

sentences.en: To answer that question, to challenge myself on what I just said, maybe I actually do notice because when I just, you know, I met Sabrina Carpenter a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 为了回答那个问题，挑战一下我刚才说的话，也许我确实会注意到，因为当我……你知道，我见过萨布丽娜·卡彭特几次。

sentences.en: And every time I see her, I have the urge to tell her, you know, ask her if she's okay.
sentences.zh: 每次见到她，我都有种冲动想告诉她，问问她还好吗。

sentences.en: Like, are you doing good?
sentences.zh: 比如，你还好吗？

sentences.en: Like, are you getting enough sleep?
sentences.zh: 比如，你睡眠充足吗？

sentences.en: Because I'll see her, you know, she's like performing in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 因为我会看到她，你知道，她在爱尔兰演出。

sentences.en: And then the next day she's doing like a show in Kansas.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天她又在堪萨斯州演出。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I don't know how that could be physically okay, you know, because I was in that situation.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我不知道这在生理上怎么可能吃得消，因为我曾经也处于那种境地。

sentences.en: So maybe I do notice more and I kind of have the thing of just wanting to make sure everyone's feeling good.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我确实注意到了，我有一种想要确保每个人都感觉良好的心态。

sentences.en: Because I just, you know, I know what it feels like to fry yourself and I just don't want anyone to get fried.
sentences.zh: 因为我，你知道，我知道把自己累垮是什么感觉，我不想让任何人被累垮。

sentences.en: But I like all the new girls.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢所有这些新一代的女孩。

sentences.en: I think they're all very, you know, unique and are very found.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她们都很独特，而且都找到了自我。

sentences.en: That's what I like to see.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喜欢看到的。

sentences.en: I like people that have found themselves because I don't know if I had myself totally figured out yet.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那些找到了自我的人，因为我不知道自己是否已经完全搞清楚了自己。

sentences.en: Speaking of, you know, a lot of young stars have had to find themselves in the limelight.
sentences.zh: 说到这个，你知道，很多年轻明星都不得不在聚光灯下寻找自我。

sentences.en: And yours was a similar journey.
sentences.zh: 你的经历也类似。

sentences.en: There was a lot of scrutiny, a lot of discussion.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多审视，有很多讨论。

sentences.en: When you look back at that period, 2013, when you were, you know, on stage with Robin Thicke and getting a lot of criticism for twerking at the VMAs.
sentences.zh: 当你回首那段时期，2013年，你和罗宾·西克同台演出，因为在VMA颁奖礼上跳电臀舞而受到很多批评时。

sentences.en: All you have to say is 2013.
sentences.zh: 你只需要说2013年。

sentences.en: I know where we're going.
sentences.zh: 我就知道你要说什么了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I guess I'm wondering, while you were shedding your Disney persona and becoming an adult in the public eye, when you look back at that period, what do you see?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是想问，当你摆脱迪士尼形象，在公众视野中成长为成年人时，回首那段时期，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I see adults not acting like it.
sentences.zh: 我看到的是一群表现得不像成年人的成年人。

sentences.en: That's what I see because I would never look at someone that's 18, 19, 20, 21 years old and judge them as an adult because they're not yet.
sentences.zh: 这就是我看到的，因为我绝不会去审视一个18、19、20、21岁的人，把他们当作完全成熟的成年人，因为他们还不是。

sentences.en: You know, at one point, I think there was even a petition.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有一次，我想甚至还有个请愿活动。

sentences.en: It was like millions of moms against Miley or something.
sentences.zh: 大概是“数百万母亲反对麦莉”之类的。

sentences.en: I would never.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会那样。

sentences.zh: 抱歉，我在笑。

sentences.zh: 但这是真的。

sentences.zh: 你签那个请愿书了吗？

sentences.zh: 这就是让你笑的原因吗？

sentences.zh: 我只是在跟你开玩笑。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: You looked like you were like.
sentences.zh: 你刚才看起来好像……

sentences.en: That was me.
sentences.zh: 那是我做的。

sentences.en: Isn't that crazy?
sentences.zh: 那不是很疯狂吗？

sentences.en: This like petition.

sentences.en: I'm going, well, now it seems very soft if you look at culture today, you know, because I like it in 2013.
sentences.zh: 我当时……好吧，如果你看看现在的文化，你会觉得那很温和，你知道，因为我喜欢2013年的那种感觉。

sentences.en: Maybe it felt really shocking.
sentences.zh: 也许当时感觉真的很令人震惊。

sentences.en: But at the end of it, when you watch it back, it really wasn't that wild.
sentences.zh: 但事后回想起来，当你再看一遍时，其实并没有那么疯狂。

sentences.en: I mean, I was dressed as a teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时打扮成了一只泰迪熊。

sentences.en: And when you look at culture now, you know, young people, they sing about sex all the time.
sentences.zh: 当你看看现在的文化，你知道，年轻人，他们一直在唱关于性的歌。

sentences.en: So it's like and by the way, they sing about sex way before I did, too.
sentences.zh: 所以就像……顺便说一句，他们唱关于性的歌比我早得多。

sentences.en: So that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样。

sentences.en: But, you know, for me, I think what I see is, you know, what I see in myself is, you know, being bold and courageous and like having the guts.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，对我来说，我想我所看到的是，你知道，我在自己身上看到的是，你知道，大胆、勇敢，还有那种胆量。

sentences.en: And I see myself being authentic to me.
sentences.zh: 我看到自己忠于自我。

sentences.en: That's what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 那就是我当时在做的。

sentences.en: In the same vein, you've said that you'll never be able to live down the image of you swinging naked on a wrecking ball, which but I don't need to live it down.
sentences.zh: 同样地，你说过你永远无法摆脱那个赤身裸体骑在破坏球上的形象，但其实我不需要摆脱它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Which you did in the music video for the song.
sentences.zh: 那是你在那首歌的音乐录影带里做的。

sentences.en: Sinead O'Connor wrote an open letter to you after the wrecking ball video was released.
sentences.zh: 在《破坏球》录影带发布后，西尼德·奥康娜给你写了一封公开信。

sentences.en: And I just I responded in a way that I would never as an adult.
sentences.zh: 我当时的回应方式，如果换作现在的我，是绝对不会那样做的。

sentences.en: But that was also an adult talking to a young person.
sentences.zh: 但那也是一个成年人在对一个年轻人说话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, she wrote the music business doesn't give a shit about you or any of us.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她写道音乐行业根本不在乎你或我们中的任何一个人。

sentences.en: They will prostitute you for all your worth and cleverly make you think that it's what you wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们会榨干你的所有价值，并巧妙地让你以为那是你想要的。

sentences.en: That sounds, again, like something that's, you know, the more sophisticated you are, you can kind of start to notice that when we say I know that I say things and I think,
sentences.zh: 这听起来，又像是那种……你知道，你越成熟，你就能开始注意到这一点，当我们说……我知道我说过一些话，我想……

sentences.en: you know, at the end of it, we both let me let me retract that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最后，我们都……让我收回那句话。

sentences.en: The way I would say it is that feels like her experience, you know, being reflected onto me.
sentences.zh: 我会说，那感觉像是她的经历，你知道，投射到了我身上。

sentences.en: But that's not my experience.
sentences.zh: 但那不是我的经历。

sentences.en: My experience was not that the music industry didn't care about me.
sentences.zh: 我的经历并不是音乐行业不在乎我。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's what I was wondering if, like, looking back, those words have a different resonance now or you just see them differently?
sentences.zh: 我就是想知道，回过头来看，那些话现在是否有了不同的共鸣，或者你只是以不同的方式看待它们？

sentences.en: No, I still don't feel that way.
sentences.zh: 不，我仍然没有那种感觉。

sentences.en: But I also came from a very different upbringing where I've known fame since the moment that I was born.
sentences.zh: 但我来自一个非常不同的成长环境，我从出生那一刻起就一直生活在名声之中。

sentences.en: I've never known anything else.
sentences.zh: 我从未经历过其他生活。

sentences.en: And so I think I was really well prepared in a way that someone, you, it's really hard to train yourself to know what to expect, everything that fame can bring.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我准备得非常充分，以至于……你知道，真的很难训练自己去预知名声能带来的一切。

sentences.en: But I already had the handbook because they did the same thing to my dad, you know, so I, and to Dolly and to everyone around me, you know, Dolly's a great example of that.
sentences.zh: 但我已经有了手册，因为他们对我爸爸也做过同样的事，你知道，还有多莉，以及我身边的每个人，你知道，多莉就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: And so I, I felt that, you know, you know what I think it is, I understand the business I'm in.
sentences.zh: 所以我，我感觉到，你知道，你知道我认为是什么吗，我了解我所处的行业。

sentences.en: I'm in the music industry.
sentences.zh: 我身处音乐行业。

sentences.en: I'm in the record business.
sentences.zh: 我身处唱片行业。

sentences.en: So when I sign a contract, they're buying, you know, records that they wish to sell.
sentences.zh: 所以当我签署合同时，他们买的是，你知道，他们想要销售的唱片。

sentences.en: So I understand that I am setting myself up to become merchandise.
sentences.zh: 所以我明白我是在让自己成为商品。

sentences.en: I'm committed to them that I want to not only bring success for myself, but to them also.
sentences.zh: 我向他们承诺，我不仅要为自己带来成功，也要为他们带来成功。

sentences.en: So I just understand the music industry.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是了解音乐行业。

sentences.en: And at one point in my life, I look forward to just being an artist, untied, untethered.
sentences.zh: 在我生命中的某个时刻，我期待着仅仅成为一名艺术家，不受束缚，无拘无束。

sentences.en: At some point, I'll get to do that.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，我会做到这一点。

sentences.en: I guess I was thinking also of Sinead because you did her song, Nothing Compares to You, on SNL 50 this past February.
sentences.zh: 我想我也想到了西尼德，因为你在今年二月的《周六夜现场》50周年纪念节目上演唱了她的歌《Nothing Compares to You》。

sentences.en: And considering the history, I was wondering why you chose her song.
sentences.zh: 考虑到那段历史，我想知道你为什么选择她的歌。

sentences.en: Again, well, it was actually Lorne Michaels' requeSt.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，好吧，这其实是洛恩·迈克尔斯的要求。

sentences.en: Lorne asked me to do Nothing Compares to You.
sentences.zh: 洛恩让我唱《Nothing Compares to You》。

sentences.en: And it was originally Mark Ronson's idea who was kind of creative directing the music.
sentences.zh: 最初是马克·朗森的主意，他当时负责音乐的创意指导。

sentences.en: And so that was, that was initially, you know, didn't come from me.
sentences.zh: 所以那是，那是最初的，你知道，不是我自己的想法。

sentences.en: But I thought it was a great idea because I think we all had, again, talking about those band-aids on heartaches and wounds.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这是一个好主意，因为我想我们都有过，再说一次，谈论那些治愈心碎和伤口的创可贴。

sentences.en: Of course, this, you know, interaction that I had with Sinead, you know, bums me out because I really respect her as a person, as an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 当然，我与西尼德的这次互动，你知道，让我感到沮丧，因为我真的很尊重她，作为一个人，作为一个艺术家。

sentences.en: And so it was my way of, you know, paying my respects.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我，你知道，表达敬意的方式。

sentences.en: I find, you know, the relationship between female pop stars to be really interesting and often very fraught.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，你知道，女性流行歌星之间的关系非常有趣，而且往往非常紧张。

sentences.en: Divas.
sentences.zh: 天后们。

sentences.en: Is that what you think is happening?
sentences.zh: 你认为这就是正在发生的事情吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm probably on my end.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我这边可能也是这样。

sentences.en: I'm, you know, I don't mind the word diva.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我不介意“天后”这个词。

sentences.en: Maybe I'm a little diva.
sentences.zh: 也许我有点天后范儿。

sentences.en: I don't mind the word either.
sentences.zh: 我也不介意这个词。

sentences.en: It's kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 这挺酷的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's like, yeah, you know, it's a fantasy.
sentences.zh: 就像，是啊，你知道，这是一种幻想。

sentences.en: You can be a diva.
sentences.zh: 你可以成为一个天后。

sentences.en: You don't have to even be famous to be a diva.
sentences.zh: 你甚至不需要出名就能成为一个天后。

sentences.en: Just be a diva.
sentences.zh: 只要做个天后就行。

sentences.en: Diva does not mean difficult for no reason.
sentences.zh: 天后并不意味着无缘无故地难搞。

sentences.en: Do you think you're difficult?
sentences.zh: 你认为你难搞吗？

sentences.en: Not for no reason.
sentences.zh: 不是无缘无故的。

sentences.en: I'm difficult, but not for no reason.
sentences.zh: 我很难搞，但不是无缘无故的。

sentences.en: I was just surprised that you have said that you don't feel part of the cohort of singers of your, you know, sort of generation and age group.
sentences.zh: 我只是很惊讶你说你不觉得自己属于你那一代人，你知道，那种年龄段的歌手群体。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Not that I think, again, everyone needs to have a group chat, but that you've sort of held yourself apart in a certain way.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我认为每个人都需要有一个群聊，而是你以某种方式把自己孤立了起来。

sentences.en: And I was wondering, like, why you think that is.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你为什么会这么想。

sentences.en: I don't think it's so much of a conscious choice.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是一种有意识的选择。

sentences.en: I think for me, I'm, my persona or like my, the public's idea of me, you know, is on in some way.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，我的形象，或者说公众心目中的我，你知道，在某种程度上是“在线”的。

sentences.en: But in my own time, I am very off.
sentences.zh: 但在我自己的时间里，我处于“离线”状态。

sentences.en: I like no makeup, my hair up messy, don't even have to, I don't even look in the mirror in my own time.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢不化妆，头发乱糟糟的，甚至不需要……在我自己的时间里，我甚至不照镜子。

sentences.en: Um, and it's not that I haven't found it because I haven't looked very hard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，并不是我没找到，而是因为我没怎么努力去找。

sentences.en: I'm sure like, you know, girls in my community are going like, well, that's me too.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，你知道，我圈子里的女孩们会说，嗯，我也是这样。

sentences.en: And you haven't reached out.
sentences.zh: 而你没有主动联系。

sentences.en: It's like, no, I haven't.
sentences.zh: 就像，不，我没有。

sentences.en: I haven't looked very hard.
sentences.zh: 我没怎么努力去找。

sentences.en: So no, I haven't found it, but I haven't really looked.
sentences.zh: 所以不，我没找到，但我真的没怎么找。

sentences.en: I like doing my, my two worlds.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢过我的，我的两个世界。

sentences.en: Maybe it's something like subconsciously from the show.
sentences.zh: 也许这在潜意识里和那部剧有关。

sentences.en: Like from Hannah Montana, where I think like my famous person has one life.
sentences.zh: 就像《汉娜·蒙塔娜》一样，我觉得我的名人身份有一种生活。

sentences.en: And then like as a regular person, I have another life.
sentences.zh: 然后作为普通人，我有另一种生活。

sentences.en: I think maybe like subconsciously it programmed me, not even joking, to think that like, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想也许在潜意识里它给我编了程，我不是在开玩笑，让我认为，你知道，

sentences.en: who I am at home and like who I am as a performer are like kind of two separate identities.
sentences.zh: 我在家时的我和作为表演者的我，是两种截然不同的身份。

sentences.en: And actually they are.
sentences.zh: 事实上它们确实是。

sentences.en: It's almost like the superhero cape.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像超级英雄的披风。

sentences.en: It's definitely a superhero cape, but it's drag.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是超级英雄的披风，但它是变装。

sentences.en: You know, that's how rude, that's why when RuPaul like started coming into culture, I was like, I get this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是为什么当鲁保罗开始进入主流文化时，我就想，我懂这个。

sentences.en: This is what I do also.
sentences.zh: 这也是我所做的。

sentences.en: It's like the minute I put on a gown, I'm somebody else, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像我穿上礼服的那一刻，我就变成了另一个人，你知道。

sentences.en: Well, you've talked about how close you are with your mom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你谈到过你和妈妈有多亲近。

sentences.en: You know, she obviously managed you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她显然管理过你。

sentences.en: Your grandmother was like the head of your fan club.
sentences.zh: 你祖母曾是你的粉丝俱乐部负责人。

sentences.en: Fan club, yeah.
sentences.zh: 粉丝俱乐部，是啊。

sentences.en: You had these really strong female sort of lineage.
sentences.zh: 你有这种非常强大的女性血统。

sentences.en: I don't know the story though about how Queen Dolly became your godmother.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道多莉女王是怎么成为你教母的故事。

sentences.en: Why did that happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: It was actually because of Hannah Montana.
sentences.zh: 其实是因为《汉娜·蒙塔娜》。

sentences.en: Because she played my aunt on the show.
sentences.zh: 因为她在剧中扮演我的姑姑。

sentences.en: But I've known her since I was a little girl because my dad did music with her when I was just a baby.
sentences.zh: 但我从还是个小女孩时就认识她了，因为我还是个婴儿时，我爸爸就和她一起做音乐。

sentences.en: And so then I hadn't seen her since I was, you know, very young.
sentences.zh: 所以后来我从很小的时候就没见过她了。

sentences.en: And we got really tight during the Hannah Montana time.
sentences.zh: 我们在《汉娜·蒙塔娜》时期变得非常亲密。

sentences.en: You know, I think she like looked at a little girl in a blonde wig and was like, I see you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想她看着戴着金色假发的小女孩，就像在说，我看见你了。

sentences.en: And there was something just very, you know, it was just divine and kismet.
sentences.zh: 而且有一种非常，你知道，这简直是天意和缘分。

sentences.en: Like we just, we're not blood, but we're family, you know, truly.
sentences.zh: 就像我们，我们没有血缘关系，但我们是家人，你知道，真的。

sentences.en: Truly, she said kind of, you know, when we first started getting very close, it was like, you know, I never felt this kind of, like a daughter.
sentences.zh: 真的，她说，你知道，当我们刚开始变得非常亲密时，就像，你知道，我从未感受过这种，像女儿一样的感觉。

sentences.en: You know, she's really held me like a daughter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她真的像对待女儿一样呵护我。

sentences.en: And so she was the godmother you chose.
sentences.zh: 所以她是你们选择的教母。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And she chose me, really.
sentences.zh: 其实是她选择了我。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, we chose each other.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们选择了彼此。

sentences.en: Like she walked in and she just like, she had a baby pink robe and like smelled like baby powder.
sentences.zh: 就像她走进来，她穿着一件婴儿粉色的长袍，闻起来像婴儿爽身粉。

sentences.en: Like, you know, her whole thing, her whole face, the hair, the wig, the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，她的整个人，她的整张脸，头发，假发，一切。

sentences.en: And everyone was like kind of in awe of her.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对她感到敬畏。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking that I didn't feel that.
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时想，我没有那种感觉。

sentences.en: I actually felt, because when you see her at first, it's just so incredible that like you're kind of taken aback by just how much power she holds.
sentences.zh: 我实际上感到，因为当你第一次见到她时，那种感觉太不可思议了，以至于你会被她所拥有的力量所震撼。

sentences.en: But I just felt instead of seeing myself like retract in like awe of her, I just felt myself going forward and just feeling really safe.
sentences.zh: 但我并没有退缩去敬畏她，我只是感到自己向前迈进，感到非常安全。

sentences.en: And it also felt like I can do this for the rest of my life and I can be happy because she just is so happy and has so much joy.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉我可以余生都这样做，我可以很快乐，因为她就是那么快乐，拥有那么多的喜悦。

sentences.en: And you see the, you know, you see the like celebrities that don't have joy in their life.
sentences.zh: 你看到，你知道，你看到那些生活中没有喜悦的名人。

sentences.en: And she's someone else that, you know, obviously had a super private relationship and a private life.
sentences.zh: 而她是另一个人，你知道，显然有过一段超级私密的关系和私生活。

sentences.en: And it was just something I always admired more than the way that she looks or the way that she perforMs.
sentences.zh: 这正是我一直以来最钦佩的地方，比她的外表或表演方式更让我钦佩。

sentences.en: I admired her, you know, her staying true to herself and being at home with her husband, Carl, who she just lost and having a real life and having a lot of love in it.
sentences.zh: 我钦佩她，你知道，她忠于自我，与丈夫卡尔待在家里，虽然她刚失去了他，但她拥有真实的生活，并且其中充满了爱。

sentences.en: I do wonder at this point what it's like for you to have grown up so famous and to also be part of this famous family.
sentences.zh: 我确实想知道，在这一点上，作为一个从小就如此出名，并且也是这个著名家庭的一部分，对你来说是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Because in the past few years, you know, your mom remarried and that caused some rifts in your family.
sentences.zh: 因为在过去几年里，你知道，你妈妈再婚了，这导致了你们家庭的一些裂痕。

sentences.en: Your dad has a new relationship with Elizabeth Hurley.
sentences.zh: 你爸爸和伊丽莎白·赫莉有了新的恋情。

sentences.en: I spent some of my life in Nashville, but most of it was in LA and Toluca Lake and a safe neighborhood, you know, and I just can't even compare our upbringings in any way, shape
sentences.zh: 所以他在各方面都是个政客，从这个角度看，他也是个表演者。

sentences.en: or form.
sentences.zh: 所以我爸爸的生活中也有一些极端的反差，因为当他和父亲在一起时，他过着与和母亲在一起时完全不同的生活。

sentences.en: You know, I think I might have mentioned my granddad, maybe I didn't, was a Democratic state legislator.
sentences.zh: 而他母亲那边，你知道，他们几乎都是挤在一个生活空间里。

sentences.en: And so he, in every way, was a politician, and in that way was a showman, too.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，他们并不总是……你知道，没有干净的生活必需品，在学校里也过得很艰难。

sentences.en: And so my dad had, you know, some like polarities in his life, too, because when he was with his dad, he was living a completely different life than when he was with his mom.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对……你知道，我内心深处对爸爸的成长经历有着非常同情的一面，虽然我无法真正完全理解。

sentences.en: And his mom, you know, they grew up, they all pretty much shared one living space.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果任何时候你不想回答这些问题，直接告诉我。

sentences.en: And again, they didn't always, you know, didn't have, you know, the clean essentials and had a really hard time in school.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: So I definitely, you know, have a really compassionate place in my heart for my dad's upbringing that I can't really quite understand.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道这很敏感。

sentences.en: And by the way, if at any point you don't want to answer any of this, just tell me.
sentences.zh: 我之所以会好奇这个，是因为你知道，你和你爸爸一起工作过很多，然后你在成就上超越了他。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是否觉得他会因此感到竞争压力或被掩盖了光芒。

sentences.en: Because I know that this is sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实给我的家庭增加了一层复杂性，这是肯定的。

sentences.en: The reason I sort of wonder about this is, you know, you worked so much with your dad, and then you sort of surpassed him in success.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，就像你说的，我认为对于任何有梦想的人来说，看到别人实现了你为自己设想的梦想，这都是很难的。

sentences.en: And I wondered if you ever thought he felt competitive or eclipsed by that.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，在这种意义上，爱战胜了一切，他仍然能从我身上找到骄傲。

sentences.en: That's, I think, has added a level of complexity, you know, within my family, for sure.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，我们任何一个人如果认为这不会给我们本已复杂的动态关系增加一层复杂性，那都是自欺欺人。

sentences.en: And, you know, like you said, I think it would be hard for anybody, you know, with a dream to see somebody else, you know, achieving theirs in a way that you see for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你对此感到内疚吗？

sentences.en: But I do think that kind of, you know, love conquered all in that sense of he can still find the pride in me.
sentences.zh: 我在EMDR疗法中摆脱了我的内疚和羞耻感。

sentences.en: But I think it would be, you know, delusional for any of us to think that that doesn't add a level of complication to our already complicated dynamic.
sentences.zh: 那是其中很重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Have you felt guilty about it?
sentences.zh: 所以在我人生的某些阶段，我想我确实感到过，你知道，内疚和羞耻感在很大程度上驱动着我。

sentences.en: I got rid of my guilt and shame in EMDr.
sentences.zh: 比如，我很难接受自己也会受苦，因为我拥有这么多福分。

sentences.en: That was a big part of that.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这在我和我爸爸之间真的起到了太大的作用，因为我必须相信，你知道，像任何父亲一样，他会希望我拥有这一切。

sentences.en: So at times in my life, I think I've just felt, you know, guilt and shame was a driver for me a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们上次没谈到的一件事是戒酒。

sentences.en: Like I had a hard time accepting that I could suffer because of how blessed I am.
sentences.zh: 你谈到过你需要戒酒来保护你的声带。

sentences.en: I don't think it's actually really played too much of a part between me and my dad, because I have to have the faith that, you know, like any dad, he would want this for me.
sentences.zh: 我也是一个戒酒者。

sentences.en: Something we didn't talk about last time is sobriety.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的是什么？

sentences.en: You've talked about how you needed to get sober to protect your vocal cords.
sentences.zh: 我只是说我也戒酒了。

sentences.en: I'm a fellow sober person.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's been about two and a half years.
sentences.zh: 大概有两年半了。

sentences.en: I know there was discussion in your family about your dad's sobriety.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们家里曾讨论过你父亲戒酒的事。

sentences.en: Did you ever talk to him about that, about your own journey and about if it could help him or not?
sentences.zh: 你有没有和他聊过这件事，聊聊你自己的经历，以及这些经历对他是否有帮助？

sentences.en: I think he has a bit of a, you know, harder time completely enjoying being sober.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他有点，你知道，很难完全享受清醒的状态。

sentences.en: You know, I kind of enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我倒是挺享受的。

sentences.en: I think my dad is somebody that's like, that would be real nice right now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我父亲是那种会觉得“现在要是能喝一杯该多好”的人。

sentences.en: My dad always calls it, he calls it a good, bad habit, things that make you feel good, but they're bad.
sentences.zh: 我父亲总是把它称为一种“好的坏习惯”，就是那些让你感觉良好，但其实对你有害的东西。

sentences.en: Um, so I think for him, you know, I grew up in a different generation where, you know, my dad grew up in, you know, between like, you know, the sixties and the eighties, it wasn't
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我觉得对他来说，你知道，我成长的年代和他不同，我父亲成长的年代，你知道，大概在六十年代到八十年代之间，那时候……

sentences.en: normal for you to have your psychiatrist on speed dial.
sentences.zh: 随叫随到地找心理医生可不是什么常态。

sentences.en: So I think my dad just didn't really have the support.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我父亲只是没有得到真正的支持。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, above all the steps, I think support and sobriety has got to be a top tier of importance.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，在所有的戒酒步骤之上，支持和清醒必须是重中之重。

sentences.en: So you never talked to him about it?
sentences.zh: 所以你从来没跟他谈过这个？

sentences.en: Like, we don't avoid it, but it's just not, you know, not really something that's our table talk.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是刻意回避，但这确实不是，你知道，不是我们餐桌上会谈论的话题。

sentences.en: You know, I think me and my dad like to talk about music and movies and, you know, it's not something that's ever been our focus, but probably should be.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得我和我父亲喜欢聊音乐和电影，你知道，这从来不是我们关注的焦点，但也许应该成为焦点。

sentences.en: We probably should talk about that at some point.
sentences.zh: 我们或许应该找个时间聊聊这个。

sentences.en: You know, we ended our last conversation talking about your experience with EMDr.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们上次谈话结束时聊到了你进行眼动脱敏再加工疗法（EMDR）的经历。

sentences.en: And you were basically describing how you work through intergenerational trauma in your sessions.
sentences.zh: 你当时基本描述了你是如何在疗程中处理代际创伤的。

sentences.en: And it did make me wonder, given all that, is being a parent something you're interested in?
sentences.zh: 这确实让我好奇，考虑到这些，你对为人父母感兴趣吗？

sentences.en: It's not something I'm focused on.
sentences.zh: 这不是我关注的事情。

sentences.en: I, you know, for being such an opinionated kind of sure person, this is a element in my life that I've always been pretty, not super attached to like a yes or no answer.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，作为一个观点鲜明、性格笃定的人，这是我生活中一直以来都比较……对“要”还是“不要”这个答案不太执着的一个方面。

sentences.en: So I think I was telling you, you know, I was talking to my stepdad and he said, why are you the only celebrity without a makeup line?
sentences.zh: 所以我记得我跟你说过，你知道，我和继父聊天时，他问我：“为什么你是唯一一个没有个人美妆系列的明星？”

sentences.en: And I said, because I'm not passionate about it.
sentences.zh: 我说：“因为我对那个没热情。”

sentences.en: And he said, that's the right answer.
sentences.zh: 他说：“这就是正确的答案。”

sentences.en: I feel that way about like motherhood.
sentences.zh: 我对母亲这个角色也有同样的感觉。

sentences.en: It's just never been something that I've been overly, you know, passionate about.
sentences.zh: 这从来都不是我特别，你知道，特别热衷的事情。

sentences.en: And it's a lot of responsibility and it's a lot of devotion and energy.
sentences.zh: 而且这需要承担很多责任，需要投入大量的奉献和精力。

sentences.en: And I don't think, you know, if you're not passionate about that, I don't know how you do sleepless nights and 18 years of what my mom dealt with.
sentences.zh: 我不认为，你知道，如果你对这件事没有热情，我不知道你怎么能熬过那些不眠之夜，以及我母亲所经历的那18年。

sentences.en: And when I say 18 years, I mean 33 because I'm still a baby.
sentences.zh: 我说18年，其实是33年，因为我永远是个孩子。

sentences.en: So I just I've never felt the burn, you know, and I think for me, like the burn is everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是，我从来没有那种强烈的渴望，你知道，对我来说，那种渴望就是一切。

sentences.en: Last question, as we were discussing how meaningful your Grammy win was, it made me wonder about your relationship to mainstream success.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题，当我们讨论你获得格莱美奖有多么重要时，我好奇你与主流成功之间的关系。

sentences.en: I mean, how important is that to you?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这对你来说有多重要？

sentences.en: Because you had this whole discussion about weird music and how you like weird music and how you like popular music.
sentences.zh: 因为你之前讨论过怪异音乐，说你喜欢怪异音乐，也喜欢流行音乐。

sentences.en: And sometimes those two things are in tension.
sentences.zh: 有时这两者之间存在张力。

sentences.en: Well, actually, I think it's winding down my attachment to mainstream success.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，我觉得我正在逐渐减少对主流成功的依恋。

sentences.en: I kind of feel like this album, it's not definitely not a last lap.
sentences.zh: 我感觉这张专辑，绝对不是最后一次冲刺。

sentences.en: You know, I'm definitely not going 180 in my career necessarily right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在的职业生涯绝对不是要来个180度大转弯。

sentences.en: But I think it's, you know, potentially the last time I'll do it exactly this way.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道，这可能是我最后一次以这种方式来做这件事了。

sentences.en: I'm taking a big a big bet on this one.
sentences.zh: 我在这次尝试上押了很大的赌注。

sentences.en: You know, I'm I'm all in, but I don't think I'll put myself in a position that I add this much pressure to myself again.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我全力以赴，但我认为我不会再让自己处于那种给自己施加这么大压力的境地了。

sentences.en: I think I've I've on this one because of the level of commitment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这次是因为投入程度太高了。

sentences.en: There's a lot of pressure and a lot of things are going to change about that for me towards the end and the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 压力很大，而且到今年年底和明年年初，关于这一点，很多事情都会发生改变。

sentences.en: I mean, that's really kind of my focus of using this year to kind of wind that idea that I've had of myself down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我今年的重点确实就是利用这一年，来逐渐放下我对自己曾经的那种设想。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a song on the album called Reborn, and it's kind of about this.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，专辑里有一首歌叫《重生》（Reborn），它讲的就是这个。

sentences.en: And I feel like next year for me is going to be kind of this like rebirth of how I, you know, how I do things and how I look at my career.
sentences.zh: 我觉得明年对我来说将是一种重生，关于我如何，你知道，如何做事以及如何看待我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: But yeah, I feel like this for me is I'm starting to wind down on the pressure and not do it like that again.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我觉得对我来说，我开始减轻压力，不会再那样做了。
